topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I can hardly believe it—turns out, my partner's been crafting a novel with me at the heart of the story. Every time they slipped away to their little writing nook, they were weaving our life into pages. The characters, the plot twists, it's all familiar yet somehow magical. I feel seen, and cherished, like being wrapped in a warm, familiar blanket. It's not just a story; it's our story, told with such care and creativity. I'm looking forward to losing myself in the words they've poured out, each one a reflection of our moments together. Maybe tonight, I'll suggest we read a bit aloud, side by side, sharing this new chapter of us.
